content:
- Model consistently overestimates prices in early forecast periods, especially after sharp spikes or volatility; reduce initial forecast values by 2–5% for high-activity periods.
- Model underestimates prices during prolonged downward trends; adjust downward bias by adding 1–3% of recent average to forecast if 3+ consecutive days show falling prices.
- Overshoots after sharp upward moves (e.g., post-70+ spikes); cap forecast at 5–10% above recent peak for 3–5 days to avoid overcorrection.
- Mean reversion bias: if forecast is >10% above 30-day moving average, reduce by 1–2% per day until convergence; if below, add 1–2% per day.
- Lagged response: if true outcome is >5% above forecast on day 1–3, model is lagging; adjust forecast upward by 1–3% for next 2–3 days.
- Horizon-specific: 30-day forecasts often underestimate volatility in high-activity months (e.g., Q3 2024); add 1–3% volatility buffer if historical std dev > 2.5% of mean.
